command: set -u; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; id -un; date -Is; echo '===SERVICE_EFFECTIVE==='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost --no-pager; echo '===INSTALLED_HASHES==='; sha256sum /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf; echo '===SEMANTIC_SUBJECTS==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do sudo -n stat -c '%n|%s|%Y' "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING_OR_UNREADABLE:$p; done; echo '===ROOT_CONTEXT_GUARD==='; set +e; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh; GRC=$?; set -e; echo ROOT_GUARD_RC=$GRC; test "$GRC" -eq 255; test "$(systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service)" = active; test "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)" = 319869; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p DropInPaths --value | grep -Fq '/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf'; echo OMEGA_INTERLOCK_ROOT_CONTEXT_VERIFIED=1; echo VM_LIFECYCLE_MUTATION=0
